results.title: competing writes — 50 rounds × 8 separate processes, exactly one winner
evidence: 50/50 rounds clean; losers STALE_REVISION=350 (of which decided by the unique constraint, details.concurrent=true: 66); CONFLICT_REVISION=0
ok  round 1: 201×1, 409 STALE×7, other×0, rows(rev 2)=1, send spread 11 ms
ok  round 50: 201×1, 409 STALE×7, other×0, rows(rev 51)=1, send spread 17 ms

results.title: lost response — committed once, identical retry is a replay, changed retry refused
evidence: server produced: HTTP/1.1 201 Created; client received: no response (UND_ERR_SOCKET)
rows for rev 2 after the lost response: 1
identical retry -> 200 idempotentReplay=true; rows 1
changed-content retry -> 409 STALE_REVISION; rows 1; stored fingerprint unchanged=true

results.title: durability — written by process 1, which is then gone; reopened by a different process 2
evidence: P1 pid 18086 boot a9a3b13e store=supabase: create 201, save 201; exit 0; port now refuses connections: true
P2 pid 18094 boot 1df3ab3c store=supabase: reopen 200; fingerprint, FurniSpec and PartGraph identical: true
negative control (memory store): same process reopen 200, fresh process reopen 404 — the test detects non-durability: true
no fixed wait is used anywhere: independence is shown by pid, boot id and a refused port

owner DELETE revision -> 403, rows affected ?

owner PATCH owner_user_id -> 403 42501
revision rows afterwards 1, fingerprint intact true

results.title: contract — CAS mandatory, malformed id == nonexistent, client ids refused
evidence: save without expectedPreviousRevision -> 400 BAD_REQUEST
GET /api/designs/not-a-uuid -> 404; identical to a nonexistent uuid: true
(PostgREST itself answers a malformed uuid filter with 400 22P02 — which is why the store must not forward it)
create with a client-chosen designId -> 400 BAD_REQUEST
design updated_at advanced after a save (column grant allows the store's touch): true

results.title: storage outage and missing configuration are reported as what they are
evidence: store unreachable: read -> 503 STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE "The design store could not be reached."
store unreachable: save -> 503 STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE "The design store could not be reached. Your design was not saved."
deployment without SUPABASE_URL, signed-in caller -> 503 PERSISTENCE_NOT_CONFIGURED
